name: ensemble
description: Generative musical accompaniment and chord visualization PWA

scripts.test: npm run check-mutations && npm run lint && vitest run --reporter=dot --silent=true
scripts.test:verbose: npm run check-mutations && npm run lint && vitest run
scripts.check-mutations: grep -rnE "(playback|chords|bass|soloist|harmony|groove|midi|vizState)\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+ = " public/components/ public/*.js | grep -v "state/" | grep -v "reducer" | grep -v "@direct-mutation" | grep -v "@worker-mutation" || true
